items.title: Johnny DeDroit Interview, 1973-03-16
items.q: So Fagan says, you fellas are great. He says, when can you start?

ctx.x: So they sent us over to the Arcadia Ballroom and they had Ray Miller there, and he had Frank Trombauer, I guess if you heard of him, played a C melody saxophone. Mike, how you played it. He had the greatest musicians in that band. Well that was the featured band. So this fellow, Fagan, who ran the place, he wanted to hear us and we played. He says, boy I'd like to put you and this band on the baseball field and see who can play the loudest. We played as loud as this big band. But Dixon, man, we hit it. You know,…
